translations.web: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
translations.bsb: A worker’s appetite works for him because his hunger drives him onward.
translations.kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth
translations.asv: The appetite of the laboring man laboreth for him; For his mouth urgeth him thereto.
